intent: Give com.kuhy.focus_owner (the Device Owner enforcer on the Pixel 6a) a real shared-family launcher icon instead of the off-family hand-written placeholder that was added only to unblock its build.
scope: Non-goal: no new accent. The family accent #B8862E is shared; apps are distinguished by glyph shape only.
Non-goal: no change to the 13 existing glyphs or to any other app's entry.
The consuming repo (~/phone-focus-mode) is committed separately; it blocks binaries, so the icon lands there in vector form.
changes: Added AppIcon(key='focus_owner', repo=~/phone-focus-mode/focus-owner, glyph='padlock-closed', accent='#B8862E', linux=False). The repo path points into the monorepo because focus-owner was absorbed as a subtree on 2026-08-24 and both the standalone clone and its GitHub repo are gone.

Added the _PADLOCK_CLOSED glyph fragment: shackle stroked (inheriting the wrapping group's round caps), body filled in the accent, keyhole punched back out in the field colour via fill-rule='evenodd'. Splitting stroke and fill is deliberate - a fully stroked padlock loses its keyhole at 48dp, a fully filled one loses the shackle's opening.

Geometry computed against style.py rather than eyeballed, per the lesson recorded on _NOTE_ASCENDER: body 292..732 x 520..792; shackle centreline r=132 about (512,520) giving an outer top of 352, inside the 232 safe edge, with legs at x=380/644 inside the body; keyhole leaves 60px of body above and 76px below the stem, both clear of MIN_NEGATIVE_SPACE=36.

verification.evidence: ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit, codespell, secret scan and 'pytest with coverage enforcement' all Passed.
44 passed. Every app_icons module reports 100% branch coverage (apps.py, glyphs.py, _glyph_art_more.py, render.py, generate.py, cli.py, preview.py, style.py all 100%).

verification.command: render.build_svg + render.rasterise at 512px and 48px into the session scratchpad
verification.evidence: Rendered and inspected both. Charcoal #1B1D21 field with the #B8862E padlock; centre_offset resolved to (0.0, -24.0). At 48px the keyhole is still a distinct hole rather than merging into the body - the specific failure the negative-space sums were computed to avoid.
Resolves to 'padlock-closed - Closed padlock with a punched-out keyhole'.

risks: The glyph is new artwork, so it is judged by eye; mitigated by rendering at both 512px and 48px and by computing the clearances instead of estimating them.
apps.py now hardcodes a path into ~/phone-focus-mode. If that repo is ever relocated the entry goes stale - the same exposure every other entry in the registry already has.

Android vector drawables support a subset of SVG. The arc and evenodd constructs used here convert cleanly, but the generated drawable is verified by an actual release build in the consuming repo rather than assumed.
rollback: git revert this commit; nothing else imports _PADLOCK_CLOSED or the focus_owner key.
After rollback, re-run python3 -m pytest python_pkg/app_icons/tests -q and confirm 44 tests still pass and coverage stays at 100%.
The consuming repo's icon commit must be reverted too, or focus-owner is left referencing a glyph the registry no longer defines.
